title: Charge sign correct
description: Essential: Student states that the particle is positively charged.

title: Specific charge correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the specific charge as q/m = g/E.

title: Radius of motion correct
description: Essential: Student identifies the radius of circular motion as L.

title: Average speed magnitude
description: Important: Student correctly calculates the magnitude of the average velocity, v_avg = (2√2 B g L) / (π E).

title: Average velocity direction
description: Important: Student states the direction of the average velocity is from point a to point c.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student applies force balance (gravity, electric, magnetic) to deduce charge sign and specific charge.

title: Geometric path analysis
description: Important: Student uses the geometry of the square and circular arc to relate radius to side length L.

title: Time calculation steps
description: Optional: Student breaks down the total time into segments for motion in magnetic, electric, and gravitational fields.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows units are consistent in final expressions for specific charge and average velocity.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns negative charge or reverses the direction of the average velocity.

title: Incorrect force balance
description: Pitfall: Student makes an error in setting up the equilibrium of electric and gravitational forces.
